note: Merged from three sweeps: seven detectors in the first, Transformer in the second, GCN in the third, because the single sweep hit an allocation failure at the normalisation step. Same configuration and same code in all three. Environment: the twenty-one records written before the crash carry no environment block, because the runner writes it only on completion. The environment recorded alongside the later two batches describes those runs and, by construction, the same configuration as the first. Any comparison across the three relies on that assumption, not on a record of it.
